text:
nina: FYI midnight deploy touches payments. My MFA rotates at 23:50 and I won't be online after 00:10. Who can press if deploy-bot needs human approval?

ops-oncall: I can respond to pages but left my YubiKey at home. people-ops, can we do a JIT grant or do we need breakglass?

people-ops: We prefer JIT. Open a ticket with approver and audit owner. exec approval needed for payments service.

ryan: I can press but don't have prod-deployer role. If people-ops can grant `temp-deployer` until 02:00 I'll take it and watch metrics. Requesting nina or ops-oncall as approver.

deploy-bot: preflight: artifact v4.1.0-payments sha=fa1ade available. canary healthy. policy: manual-approve + MFA required for prod-deployer.

nina: I'll be approver until 00:10. Please pin artifact and create rollback tag before pressing. Commands: `ci-tool pin --env prod --artifact v4.1.0-payments --sha fa1ade` and `git tag -a rollback/v4.0.9 -m "pre v4.1.0" 0c0ffee`.

people-ops: Ticket created JIT-7777 and granted `temp-deployer` to ryan from 23:55-02:00. Audit owner = nina. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIT-7777

ryan: Pin and tag done. Dashboards up. Starting deploy when grant active. `/deploy prod payments v4.1.0 --pin`

deploy-bot: manual-approval-pending for prod-deployer. MFA prompt will be required for approver.

nina: Approved via MFA at 00:00.

deploy-bot: deploy-2222 started. canary at 5%. logs: https://ci.redwood/deploy-2222

ryan: Canary +10m stable. No error spikes. Will hold for 20m then promote. Rollback tag ready if needed.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor pages. If errors >1% sustained, execute rollback per playbook.

ryan: Promoted to 25% then full after smoke. All good. Documenting grant and audit links in JIT-7777.

nina: Thanks team. Good handoff.
